summary: Prefixing generated xunit/unittest fixture names with an underscore correctly restores the pre-6.2.0 behavior of marking them private so they are hidden from `pytest --fixtures` without `-v`. Change is minimal, consistent across all four xunit injectors plus the unittest helper, and carries no real regression risk since these autouse fixtures use internal generated names.

issues.description: pytest convention expects a changelog/ news fragment for user-visible fixes; none shown in the source diff (may be omitted like tests, so non-blocking).
Theoretical: any user code referencing these autouse fixtures by their generated name would break, but the names are internal/undocumented and unique-per-object, so practical impact is negligible.
